video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Practice Media Availability 🎙️ | Jabari Walker | 10.05.26

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on building team structure and foundation during training camp
quotes.excerpt: It's not going to be perfect day one, but keeping the same foundation mentally to create these building blocks.
quotes.quote: It's just creating structure, details, and what we're trying to accomplish. Understanding it's not going to be perfect day one, but keeping the same foundation mentally to create these building blocks. So, I think the expectation of what we're trying to do with focus every day, we set that standard last week so now we know what it looks like moving forward.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker on the Sixers training camp focus: It is about creating structure and details. Understanding it is not going to be perfect day one but keeping the same foundation mentally to create these building blocks.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on Joel Embiid's competitive nature during practice
quotes.excerpt: I like when Joel's talking crazy and just being competitive. And that's how you know when Joel feels good.
quotes.quote: I like when Joel's talking crazy and just being competitive. And that's how you know when Joel feels good. So, Joel's been competitive and blocking shots and doing what he does, so I'm not worried about him at all.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker says Joel Embiid is looking good in practice: I like when Joel is talking crazy and just being competitive. That is how you know when Joel feels good. He has been blocking shots and doing what he does.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on the importance of team cohesion and shared sacrifice
quotes.excerpt: Everybody has the same story of okay, this team was close and that's how we won.
quotes.quote: Everybody has the same story of okay, this team was close and that's how we won. So, that's what we're trying to do and it requires everyone to be close and everyone has questions and gets to know each other. So, that's been the fun part.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker emphasizes the importance of team cohesion for the Sixers: Everybody has the same story of this team was close and that is how we won. That is what we are trying to do.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on the team's collective commitment to sacrifice
quotes.excerpt: I have no problem sacrificing and I think we have the same with the characters we have.
quotes.quote: I'm comfortable with who I am and my beliefs and I want to win. So, it's going to be shown and I have no problem sacrificing and I think we have the same with the characters we have. They're all willing to sacrifice and that's what I've learned since stepping in, that these guys just want to win.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker on the Sixers roster: I have no problem sacrificing and I think we have the same with the characters we have. They are all willing to sacrifice and that is what I have learned since stepping in.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on his personal growth and comfort level this season
quotes.excerpt: I feel way better at this point than I did last year.
quotes.quote: I feel way better at this point than I did last year and just the message has been the same from coach, shoot the ball. And you know, that was the message he left me with last year and so it just made me put in so much extra work and I think it showed this training camp where I've just been shooting the ball comfortably.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker says he feels much better entering this season: The message has been the same from coach, shoot the ball. It made me put in so much extra work and I think it showed this training camp where I have been shooting comfortably.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on the team's willingness to sacrifice for winning
quotes.excerpt: They understand what it takes to win and everyone's just looking for this opportunity.
quotes.quote: They understand what it takes to win and everyone's just looking for this opportunity. So, I think we'll see different sides of different people now that this situation looks different. So, the idea of ego and things like that is kind of going out the window. Now it's just like, how do we figure it out?
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker on the Sixers culture: The idea of ego and things like that is kind of going out the window. Now it is just like, how do we figure it out?

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on the inclusive culture of the 76ers training camp
quotes.excerpt: This is the most included I've felt in any training camp.
quotes.quote: This is the most included I've felt in any training camp. So, it just shows that the stereotype of high-end guys and high-end athletes that sometimes it's not what the media makes it.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on the team's long-term focus and development
quotes.excerpt: I've been around to know that the best basketball is later in the season.
quotes.quote: I've been around to know that the best basketball is later in the season. So, there's been teams that don't even win right now that make a run later. So, I think our biggest thing is just creating the foundation right now, seeing what that looks like, and then our best basketball should be later on, postseason, and even after that.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker on the Sixers long-term outlook: I have been around to know that the best basketball is later in the season. Our biggest thing is just creating the foundation right now.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on the value of live reps and film study
quotes.excerpt: It's important to see some live reps against another team and to most importantly get film.
quotes.quote: It's important to see some live reps against another team and to most importantly get film. It's different when you're playing each other, but to get some film on some live reps against another opponent, I think that gives us a different progression that we haven't had yet.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker on the value of preseason reps: It is important to see some live reps against another team and to most importantly get film. That gives us a different progression that we have not had yet.

quotes.speaker: Jabari Walker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jabari Walker on Nick Nurse's coaching style and team communication
quotes.excerpt: Nick is just comfortable with himself and he's done this before.
quotes.quote: Nick is just comfortable with himself and he's done this before. So, just like we have guys that have been there and Nick is a coach that's done it before, he doesn't have to prove anything in that sense. I think sometimes less is more and he just says what needs to be said and I think we, it's important for the group to talk. So, we talk with each other and a lot of that figures itself out, but Nick does everything he needs to do.
quotes.social_post: Jabari Walker on Nick Nurse: Nick is comfortable with himself and he has done this before. Sometimes less is more and he just says what needs to be said.
